description: Lore & universe wiki keeper for world-building / roleplay servers. Indexes a local markdown lore vault (characters, places, factions, rules, artifacts) and answers canon questions with sourced excerpts — "What are the rules of travel in Sector 4?" returns the actual canon text, never a guess. Entries can carry WITH expiry rules (retire at arc N, or N days/weeks after their stamp) so superseded canon stops influencing answers; retcon marks keep deliberate exceptions alive.
